title: Viscous Gyre
subtitle: Stommel-Munk Oceanic Stream Function
description: Planetary boundary layer ocean circulation driven by non-linear wind stress curl, modeled via the Stommel double-gyre stream function.
mathNotation: \psi(x, y) = -\frac{\tau_0}{\pi \rho H \beta} \sin(\pi x) \sin(2\pi y), \quad u = -\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial y}, \quad v = \frac{\partial \psi}{\partial x}
formulaCompact: u = 2π sin(πx) cos(2πy),  v = -π cos(πx) sin(2πy)
